lectures.title: Rivers of Andhra Pradesh: the Godavari and Krishna systems

parts.t: Godavari: origin, course and Cotton's dam
items: **Width:** the Godavari has a width of **2.7 km** at **Rajahmundry**.
**Sir Arthur Cotton's dam:** on the Godavari at **Dhawaleswaram**; Dhawaleswaram Dam, Sir Arthur Cotton, **1852**.
**Seven branches:** the Godavari divides into **7 branches** in erstwhile East Godavari & West Godavari.

parts.t: The seven branches of the Godavari
items: Joins the Bay of Bengal at **Yanam**
Joins the Bay of Bengal at **Antarvedi**
**Important tributaries of Godavari:** Manjeera; Pranahita; Indravathi; Kinnerasani; Sabari; Sileru.
**Sileru:** tributary of Sabari; originates in AP; flows through Odisha.
**Sileru–Sabari confluence:** Sileru joins Sabari at the tri-junction boundary of AP, Chhattisgarh and Odisha.
**Upper reaches:** Sileru is known as **Machkand** in its upper reaches.
**Course:** initially flows northward, then eastward; enters Odisha.
**Duduma Waterfalls** are located on this river.
**Srisailam Hydroelectric Power Station:** on the Krishna River.
**Puligada:** the Krishna splits into two branches at Puligada, **64 km below Vijayawada**.
**Diviseema:** lies between the two branches of the Krishna.
**Mouth:** the Krishna enters the Bay of Bengal at **Hamsaladeevi**.
**Tungabhadra:** the biggest and most important tributary of the Krishna.
**Hagari:** the biggest tributary of the Tungabhadra.
**Vedavathi / Hagari:** tributary of Tungabhadra; Vedavathi joins the Tungabhadra near **Siruguppa**.
**Vedavathi:** rises from the Western Ghats; flows through Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
**Hagari:** Vedavathi is also called Hagari in some parts of AP.

lectures.title: Rivers of Andhra Pradesh: the Penna and the smaller rivers

items: **Somasila Dam:** on the Penna, near Nellore.
**Mouth:** the Penna joins the Bay of Bengal at **Vutukuru (Utukuru), Nellore district**.
**Important tributaries of Penna:** Cheyyeru; Chitravathi; Kundu; Papagni.
Formed by confluence of Bahuda + Pancha
**Vamsadhara:** the biggest river born in the Eastern Ghats.
**Mouth:** joins the Bay of Bengal at **Kalingapatnam**.
**Mouth:** joins the Bay of Bengal at **Mopasu Bandar**.
**Asia's 1st Rubber Dam** was built on **Janjavathi**, a tributary of Nagavali.
**Mouth:** joins the Bay of Bengal near **Konada**.
**Tributaries:** Eduvampula Gedda, Chitti Gedda, Pothula Gedda, Gadi Gedda.
**Other projects:** Tarakarama Thirtha Sagaram, Kumili Dam.
**Mouth:** joins the Bay of Bengal through an estuary near **Bheemunipatnam**.
**Basin:** 3% of Visakhapatnam district lies in the Gosthani basin.
**Temples:** Tirumala and Srikalahasthi temples are located in the Swarnamukhi basin.
**Historical name:** **Mogaleru** in the works of Dhurjati.
**Kalyani:** tributary of Swarnamukhi; **Kalyani Dam** was constructed on Kalyani.
**Origin:** Sadasivakonda, Narayanavanam Protected Forest, Chittoor district.
**Mouth:** joins the south-western tip of **Pulicat Lake** and then enters the Bay of Bengal.
**Tammileru:** forms the boundary between **Krishna and West Godavari districts**.
**River forming the Krishna–West Godavari boundary:** recall **Tammileru**.

corrections.corrected: Mouth: the Penna joins the Bay of Bengal at Vutukuru (Utukuru), Nellore district.

corrections.corrected: Janjavathi Rubber Dam: Janjavathi; Parvathipuram Manyam district (Komarada mandal); Asia's 1st Rubber Dam.
corrections.checked: The rubber dam is across the Jhanjavathi near Rajyalakshmipuram, Komarada mandal, Parvathipuram (Manyam) district, not Srikakulam (https://www.thehansindia.com/andhra-pradesh/jalaarathi-offered-to-jhanjavati-river-975826 ; https://infinitylearn.com/surge/study-materials/english/geography/first-rubber-dam-in-india/)

corrections.checked: The Chandravanka joins the Krishna about 3 km after the falls, downstream of Nagarjuna Sagar dam, not in the reservoir (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethipothala_Falls)
